Killable }} '''Grand Inquisitor Isillien''' is a [[human]] priest and the spiritual heart of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] in the [[Western Plaguelands]]. Along with Highlord [[Alexandros Mograine]] and [[High General Abbendis]], he was one of the original founders of the [[Scarlet Crusade]].[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Corrupted_Ashbringer/Scarlet_Monastery_Event Corrupted Ashbringer/Scarlet Monastery Event] During his time in the Crusade, he had taken on [[Taelan Fordring]] as his pupil and had envisioned grand plans for him. However, Taelan eventually came to realize just how far the [[Scarlet Crusade]] had fallen from its noble purpose, and defected. As he made his way down the road from [[Hearthglen]] to meet his father by the forest's edge, he was met by Isillien, who had been charged by [[Grand Crusader Dathrohan]] with eliminating him and his newfound allies. He was willing to do this for pleasure, not of obligation or duty; for he considered the Fordring bloodline weak. The Inquisitor stroked down Taelan. Not long after, [[Tirion Fordring]] arrived and, upon seeing his son's body, flew into a rage and attacked the Crusader, killing him.{{questlong|Neutral|60+|In Dreams}} ==Abilities== * '''Dominate Mind''' — Takes control of a humanoid enemy up to level 25 for 15 sec. * '''Mana Burn''' — Hits nearby enemies with anti-mana bolts. For each point of mana consumed from a target, that target takes 1 damage. * '''Mind Blast''' — Inflicts Shadow damage to an enemy, but causes a high amount of threat. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Isillien}} [[Category:Humans characters]] [[Category:Scarlet Crusade]] [[Category:Western Plaguelands mobs]]
